job: Turn a product's whole look, one JSON record, into tokens, a stylesheet or a palette.
purpose: A pure ES module, fire/js/theme.js, that runs in Node and in the browser. A theme record names a palette, a tone, a type set and the dials; validateTheme checks it, expandTheme returns its tokens and attributes, themeToCss writes a stylesheet, paletteFrom builds a palette from an accent or brand colours, and toThemeRecord and fromThemeRecord convert to and from the Tweaks panel's state.
useWhen: A product stores its look as data and must apply it on the server, in a build step or in an email.
An agent or a design tool writes a theme and needs it checked before it is applied.
A strict content security policy forbids inline styles: write the record as a stylesheet with themeToCss.

avoidWhen.when: A person is trying looks out in the browser.
A single token needs a different value on one page.
avoidWhen.instead: Set the custom property in your own stylesheet.

states.name: invalid
states.how: validateTheme(record) returns the problems; an unknown field is an error

states.name: default
states.how: a missing field is Fire's default; {} is the default look
